question: Does one added line in the strategic prompt make the local 4B pick the more severe of two machines in warning, without hurting the other cases or the text?
line: When more than one machine is in warning, focus on the one with the worst readings: highest wear, then vibration, then temperature.
where: Inserted by the eval after the 'Prioritize safety interlocks...' line of aiEngine.strategicPrompt, for the local backend only. App code is not changed during the test; the cloud backends receive strategicPrompt too and are not measured here.

design.config: Qwen3.5-4B-q4f16_1-MLC with the fast lane (Qwen3.5-0.8B routing at 914fde01), temperature 0.7, as shipped
design.cases: the 10 --healthy-base strategic cases plus 4 more two-anomaly cases (pairs written now, before measuring: rm-101 worse than sifter-b, packer-2 worse than rm-102, sifter-a worse than packer-0, rm-104 worse than silo-2)
design.repeats: 5 per arm in one page load, arms alternating per repeat, every parsed answer stored
design.verified: every severity-arm prompt is checked to contain the line, every base-arm prompt to lack it

adoptIf: two-anomaly hits(severity) - hits(base) >= 5, out of 30 per arm
other cases: hits(severity) >= hits(base) - 1, out of 40 per arm
parsed(severity) >= parsed(base) - 1, out of 70 per arm
formulaic share (temperature_read.py) of severity no more than 0.05 above base
rule.ifPass: add the line to strategicPrompt for the local backend only (D-025); cloud prompts unchanged until measured

deviation.what: The single 5-repeat page load crashed after about 80 minutes ('Target page, context or browser has been closed', machine load 122-175, no results written). It is rerun as 5 page loads of 1 repeat each, both arms in every load, arm order alternating between loads (base first in loads 1, 3, 5). Pooled across loads; the rule is unchanged.
